The 2022 Oncobiome's GA meeting took place in Torino, IT.

The [Oncobiome](https://www.oncobiome.eu) project had its 2022's General Assembly
meeting hosted by our colleagues in Torino, Dr Alessio Naccarati (IIGM) and
Dr Francesca Cordero (University of Turin). At the meeting, Drs. Budinská and
Popovici presented our group's recent results on building predictors based on
miRNA and metagenomics data.
